landing.title: See change. Decide with context.
landing.sub: Brief microtasks, a personal reference, and a clear statistical trend.
landing.howTitle: A signal that grows with you
landing.how1b: Six valid sessions form a personal baseline.
landing.how2b: Each session adds a comparable observation.
landing.how3b: The result describes change relative to your pattern.
landing.note: CogniSignal is a non-diagnostic statistical monitor. A stable signal does not rule out a condition. If changes in daily life concern you, talk with a health professional.

info.howLead: A comparison with yourself over time.
info.medicalBody: CogniSignal offers an experimental statistical monitor of observed changes. It does not diagnose or predict Alzheimer’s, mild cognitive impairment, or dementia, and it does not replace a health evaluation. A stable signal does not rule out a condition. If you notice changes affecting daily life, talk with a health professional.
info.faqA1: No. It summarizes variation relative to your own pattern and does not estimate clinical probabilities.
info.faqA2: The model uses six valid sessions as a preliminary reference. This choice and the microtasks still need prospective validation.
info.faqQ3: Can I compare myself with others?
info.faqA3: No. The calculation uses your own reference, not population norms.
info.privacyBody: In this version, session history is stored locally in your browser. Age and results are not sent to a server. If you clear this site’s browser data, your local history will be removed.
info.termsBody: By using this experience, you understand it is an experimental statistical tracking tool, not a diagnostic device. Complete tasks in conditions that are comfortable for you and do not use results for medical decisions without consulting a professional.
